newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate rises to 53 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate rises to 53 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds rose to 53 percent at the previous day's auction from 51 percent last week.

The BNR raised its minimum permitted rate on one-week funds to 53 percent from 51, in what traders saw as a move to slightly tighten monetary policies to shield the local leu from the pressure of a usual pre-winter dollar hoarding.
The BNR's offer of 700 billion lei was undersubscribed with two commercial banks entering a total bid of 380 billion lei at prices equalling the minimum permitted rate.
Dealers said they had expected the undersubscription as the market was flooded with leu funds.
